cues.zh: 这里是Ipley Cross，位于英格兰西南部新森林的中央。
cues.en: This is Ipley Cross, in the middle of the New Forest, in south-west England.

cues.zh: 我找不到英国最危险十字路口的官方统计数据，
cues.en: I couldn't find any official statistics for the most dangerous crossroads in Britain,

cues.zh: 但这绝对算得上一个。
cues.en: but this is certainly a contender.

cues.zh: 因为尽管这里安静又乡村，车流量不大，
cues.en: Because even though it's quiet and rural here, there's not much traffic,

cues.zh: 这里平均每年发生两起事故。
cues.en: there's an average of two incidents a year here.

cues.zh: 过去十年里，有两名骑行者死于几乎一模一样的碰撞：
cues.en: Two cyclists have died in the last ten years in near-identical crashes:

cues.zh: 两次都是司机没有停车，
cues.en: both times, a driver failed to stop

cues.zh: 撞上了在主路上有优先通行权的骑行者。
cues.en: and hit a cyclist who had right-of-way on the main road.

cues.zh: 但这里的视野非常好。
cues.en: But the visibility is excellent here.

cues.zh: 标志也很完善。实际上，真的非常非常完善，
cues.en: It's well-signed. Actually, really, really well signed,

cues.zh: 现在我到了这里，很明显，这么乡村的交叉口有这么多道路标线。
cues.en: now I'm here it's obvious there's a lot of road markings for such a rural junction.

cues.zh: 但人们还是不断在这里受伤。
cues.en: But people keep getting hurt here.

cues.zh: 那为什么这里这么糟糕呢？
cues.en: So why is it so bad?

cues.zh: 这项研究多亏了一个叫Bez的人。
cues.en: For the research here, I'm indebted to someone called Bez.

cues.zh: 这是我唯一能找到的名字，我没能查到这个人，
cues.en: That's the only name I could find, I couldn't track them down,

cues.zh: 他们也没回消息，
cues.en: they didn't reply to messages,

cues.zh: 但Bez写了一篇决定性文章，讲清楚了为什么这个地方如此糟糕。
cues.en: but Bez wrote the definitive article on why this place is such a disaster.

cues.zh: 假设有一名司机从侧路驶来，时速大约40英里。
cues.en: Let's say there's a driver approaching on the side road at around 40mph.

cues.zh: 他们没有减速，因为他们很鲁莽，
cues.en: They're not slowing down, because they're reckless,

cues.zh: 而且他们能看到主路是畅通的。
cues.en: and they can see the main road is clear.

cues.zh: 这是他们的视角。
cues.en: Here's their view.

cues.zh: 直到最后一秒，骑车人都正好处在盲区里
cues.en: The cyclist, until the very last second, was exactly in the blind spot

cues.zh: 这个盲区是司机的车门立柱造成的。
cues.en: caused by the driver's door pillar.

cues.zh: 司机没有为停车标志减速，而减速本可以让他们看到骑车人。
cues.en: The driver didn't slow down for the stop sign, which would have shown them the cyclist.

cues.zh: 他们没有转头，而转头本可以让他们看到骑车人。
cues.en: They didn't move their head, which would have shown them the cyclist.

cues.zh: 涉及的速度不一定非得是某个魔咒般的坏数字。
cues.en: The speed involved doesn't have to be some magic bad number.

cues.zh: 由于这些道路的角度，
cues.en: Because of the angle of these roads,

cues.zh: 对于鲁莽司机可能行驶的每一种速度，
cues.en: for every possible speed that a reckless driver might be travelling at,

cues.zh: 都存在一个自行车在主路上的合理速度
cues.en: there is a reasonable speed for a cyclist on the main road

cues.zh: 能让骑行者一直处于那个盲区里。
cues.en: that'll keep them right in that blind spot all the way.

cues.zh: 但骑行者为什么看不到那辆车呢？
cues.en: But why won't the cyclist see the car?

cues.zh: 没错，他们有优先通行权，但他们肯定会注意到车子没有减速啊。
cues.en: They have right of way, yes, but surely they'd notice that the car's not slowing down.

cues.zh: 如果这两条路是直角相交的，
cues.en: Well, if these two roads were crossing at right angles to each other,

cues.zh: 是的，他们就能看到。
cues.en: yes, they would see them.

cues.zh: 别误会，司机仍然是鲁莽的，
cues.en: Don't get me wrong, the driver would still be reckless,

cues.zh: 但至少骑行者会注意到，并能够采取避让措施。
cues.en: but at least the cyclist would notice and be able to take evasive action.

cues.zh: 但这两条路并不是直角相交。
cues.en: But these roads aren't at right angles.

cues.zh: 这里还有一个微妙之处：在这种情况下，汽车是从骑行者身后驶来的。
cues.en: There's one other subtle thing here: in this situation, the car is approaching from behind the cyclist.

cues.zh: 骑行者看到它时为时已晚。
cues.en: The cyclist won't see it until it's too late.

cues.zh: 即使他们看到了，当汽车和自行车同时猛踩刹车时，
cues.en: And even if they do, when both car and bicycle slam on their brakes,

cues.zh: 简单的模拟就不再管用了。
cues.en: simple simulations don't work any more .

cues.zh: 因为到那时就不是三角函数的问题了，而是人的反应问题
cues.en: Because it's not up to trigonometry at that point, it's up to human reactions

cues.zh: 以及双方如何试图避免碰撞。
cues.en: and how both of them try to avoid the collision.

cues.zh: 这个路口的角度再糟糕不过了。
cues.en: This junction is at the worst possible angle.

cues.zh: 而这是偶然形成的：你能在旧地图上看到
cues.en: And it happened by accident: you can see on old maps

cues.zh: 这只是两条小路恰好相交的角度，
cues.en: that this was just the angle at which two paths happened to intersect,

cues.zh: 而这些小路恰好随着时间推移变成了道路。
cues.en: and those were the paths that happened to become roads over time.

cues.zh: 如今不会这样建了：但在20世纪初的某个时候，
cues.en: This wouldn't be built nowadays: but at some point in the early 20th century,

cues.zh: 在人们能以这种速度在公路上行驶之前，
cues.en: before it was possible to travel by road at these sorts of speeds,

cues.zh: 这曾是个合理的路口。
cues.en: this was a reasonable junction.

cues.zh: 当地议会做了一些改动。不只是重新刷了漆：
cues.en: The local council has made some changes. Not only the paint:

cues.zh: 但你能在Google街景上看到，这里的标志以前是“让行”，而不是“停车”。
cues.en: but you can see on Google Street View that the signs here used to be 'give way', not 'stop'.

cues.zh: 停车标志在英国真的很罕见，
cues.en: Stop signs are really rare in Britain,

cues.zh: 它们只应在像这样的特殊情况下使用，
cues.en: they're only meant to be used in exceptional circumstances like this,

cues.zh: 而且几乎所有人都是直接开过去。
cues.en: and almost everyone just rolls through them anyway.

cues.zh: 而且它们显然没起作用，因为人们不断受伤。
cues.en: And they're clearly not working, because people keep getting hurt.

cues.zh: 那为什么还没重新设计呢？
cues.en: So why hasn't it been redesigned?

cues.zh: 在接近路段设置减速带或弯道可以解决问题，
cues.en: Speed bumps or a chicane on the approach would solve the problem,

cues.zh: 但除非同时有路灯，否则设置这些是不合法的，
cues.en: but it's not legal to have those unless you also have street lighting,

cues.zh: 而这将意味着要花费巨资铺设数英里的新电缆。
cues.en: which would mean laying miles of new electrical cable at enormous expense.

cues.zh: 这还是假设你能绕过所有法规，
cues.en: That's assuming you could get around all the regulations

cues.zh: 这些法规将这一区域划定为保护区，
cues.en: that define this area as a conservation area,

cues.zh: 以及当地人对安装明亮照明的反对，
cues.en: and the objections from the locals about putting bright lighting

cues.zh: 因为这里以暗夜星空而闻名。
cues.en: in a place famed for its dark skies.

cues.zh: 红绿灯也有同样的问题。
cues.en: Same problem with a traffic light.

cues.zh: 最好的方案是错开交叉口，把两条辅路弯成弧线
cues.en: The best solution is to stagger the crossing, to curve the two side roads

cues.zh: 让它们与主路成直角相交，迫使司机减速。
cues.en: so they meet the main road at right angles, force the drivers to slow down.

cues.zh: 但还是那个问题：保护区、保守的当地人，
cues.en: But again: conservation area, conservative locals,

cues.zh: 以及约10万英镑的预算估算。
cues.en: and a budget estimated at around £100,000.

cues.zh: 当然，最便宜、最简单的解决办法
cues.en: The cheapest and easiest way to solve it, of course,

cues.zh: 就是让司机在停车标志前停下。
cues.en: would be for drivers to stop at the stop sign.

cues.zh: 但道路安全，乃至任何人的安全，都不该依赖对人性的信任。
cues.en: But road safety, and anyone's safety, shouldn't require faith in human nature.

cues.zh: 感谢Bez，不管你是谁！
cues.en: Thank you to Bez, whoever you are!

cues.en: The research for this video started with that article, so

cues.en: I've put a link in the description, please do go and read it.
